A valuable '''ring''' that was a unique treasure was given as a gift by the [[Unidentified King of Gascon|king]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gascon]] to [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Queen/Legends|queen]], [[Marilla]]. The queen in turn gifted the [[Ring/Legends|ring]] to her lover, the [[Prime Minister (Demigue)|Prime Minister]] of the planet [[Demigue]]. Following the formation of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Gascon's [[King/Legends|king]] announced a ball to be had in a [[Standard week/Legends|week's]] [[Time/Legends|time]]. In order to prevent her affair from being revealed, Marilla tasked a group of individuals with retrieving the ring from Demigue in time for the ball.<ref name="Envoy">{{WEGCite|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Screen|story=Envoy to the Queen}}</ref>
